❯ how is the access fix going

● Rosa's review found a gap in the access check:

  What she found: the check only looked at the caller's team. Someone on an allowed team could still run the
  hosted model on a board another team had shared with them, so that team's notes would reach it.

  The fix: the hosted model now runs only if every team whose notes the call can read has it switched on. That
  covers the caller's team, the board's team, and the teams of the board's linked sources. An unknown team counts
  as switched off.
  - Every call now passes the board it reads, so no call site can skip the check.
  - New test for her case: the caller's team is allowed, another team shares a board, and the call gets a 403
    until that team allows it.
  - I replied to and resolved her two threads and re-requested her review.

  CI: all 18 checks pass on 3c41e2b. Preview: rebuilt at 3c41e2b; the blocked call now gets a 403 with the new
  message.

  Still waiting on:
  - Rosa's approval. After that I need your OK to merge this PR.
  - Staging teams: which ones do the nightly import and digest runs use? Their switch needs turning on right after
    the staging deploy.
  - After merge: confirm the production board, then I'll switch the model on for it.
